meta.title: No Remorse
meta.author: Brain Control (the Tunefish authors; the composer is not named in the repository)
meta.description: No Remorse, a Tunefish 4 example module (16 instruments, 100 BPM) that ships with Tunefish. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: The Tunefish module (.tfm) was converted by `synth-convert tfm` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64 with its insert effects as track devices, kinds 65-73), then imported to song/1 with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns with variants, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat; track names from the original project where it has them). Events are placed at the start of the 512-frame block that fires them in the Tunefish player. Instruments and effects are the unified equivalents of the Tunefish ones and sound close to, not identical with, the original; the random per-voice detune GenSlop is not converted and the wavetable phases are drawn from a different random sequence.

about.style: melodic synth electro / slow house, dark minor-key and driving
about.tempo: 100 BPM, steady four-on-the-floor with 8th- and 16th-note sequences
about.engine: Tunefish 4: PADsynth-style wavetable generator with unison layers, band noise, ladder/RBJ filters, distortion, delay, reverb, EQ
about.description: A one-bar-chord pad and an 8th-note D pluck open the track (bars 1-8), hats enter at bar 9 and a 16th-note bass arp at bar 13; kick and snare drop in at bar 21 and two low bass sequences plus extra snare layers at bar 29. A low riff (bars 37-52) and a tremolo arp (bars 45-53) lead into the peak at bars 53-72 with chord stabs, an 8th-note chord pulse and an echoing lead; the drums stop around bar 77 and the basses and hats carry the outro to bar 85. The tonal centre is D minor (D, F, G, A, B-flat, C).

about.engine: Tunefish 4: fixed-frequency generator (about 48 Hz) with a fast envelope pitch drop, band noise 55 Hz-5.2 kHz, ladder low-pass 1.28 kHz, power distortion 0.36
about.description: Plays on every beat from bar 21 to bar 77 (pattern A, then a variant from bar 33). Distortion adds punch and a small compact reverb gives it some room.

about.style: tone-plus-noise snare with a big damped reverb
about.engine: Tunefish 4: fixed 180 Hz tone with a pitch envelope plus noise up to 6 kHz, resonant RBJ high-pass 174 Hz, power distortion, 3-band EQ
about.description: Two hits per bar from bar 21 to bar 77. A wide, heavily damped reverb (wet 0.29) makes it the main backbeat layer.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: full-harmonic wavetable two octaves down, 4 detuned unison layers, ladder low-pass 7.2 kHz, 1.2 Hz LFO on the layer count, long-slope amp envelope
about.description: An 8th-note line on G, B-flat, C and D in the first and second octave, from bar 29 to the end (bar 85). Dry, with no effects, so it sits under the mix.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: 10 detuned unison layers of a full-harmonic table, ladder low-pass 3 kHz, sustaining amp envelope, 3 voices
about.description: Three-note chords in the D4-D5 range during the peak section, bars 53-73. A stereo ping-pong delay widens them.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: few, heavily damped harmonics with 9 unison layers, slight drive, open low-pass, decaying envelope that also modulates layers and pan, 3 voices
about.description: Pulses three-note chords in 8th notes in the D3-D4 range during bars 53-69, under the brighter stabs. Delay and a wide, fully damped reverb blur it into a rhythmic pad.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: wavetable two octaves down with drive, 3 unison layers, ladder low-pass 4 kHz, envelope-to-pitch blip
about.description: A G-B-flat-C-D riff in the G2-D3 range during bars 37-52, the first melodic hook. A short stereo delay and light reverb follow it.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: 10-layer unison wavetable, open ladder low-pass 12.5 kHz, slow envelope on layers; reverb into distortion into a long delay (decay 0.75)
about.description: A quiet melody of long notes (C5-B-flat5) at the start of the peak section, bars 53-61. The reverb, distortion and long feedback delay turn it into an echoing background line.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: same full-harmonic, 4-layer patch as Bass, three octaves down, 2 Hz LFO on the layer count
about.description: A rolling 16th-note bassline mostly on D, G, B-flat and C in the lowest octaves, bars 29-81, with accents (velocity 64-127). It doubles the 8th-note Bass and drives the groove.

about.tempo: steady pattern, about 6 hits per bar
about.engine: Tunefish 4: noise only, band 8.3-16.6 kHz, very short gate envelope
about.description: Runs from bar 9 to the end of the song (bar 85) as the main timekeeper. Light small-room reverb.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: 5 unison layers, ladder low-pass 3.6 kHz, 0.46 Hz LFO on the layer count and the oscillator gain, envelope-driven panning
about.description: An arpeggio centred on D4 that reaches up to D5, bars 45-53, leading into the peak. Delay and a mid-size reverb spread it out.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: noise only, high-pass 10 kHz, short decay
about.description: Plays four longer hits per bar from bar 37 to the end. A wet, wide reverb (wet 0.5) gives it a washy tail.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: loud band noise 1.7-7 kHz plus a driven 10-layer wavetable, very short decay, EQ high cut, short delay
about.description: Adds a bright noise crack to the backbeat from bar 29 to bar 77. A short slap delay and reverb thicken it.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: full-harmonic table with 10 detuned unison layers, ladder low-pass 3 kHz, short decay with sustain
about.description: The opening hook: 8th notes hammering on D3 with F, A and C, from bar 5 to bar 69, in three patterns (bars 1, 33 and 57). Delay and a large reverb make it shimmer.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: fixed 205 Hz tone plus band noise 430 Hz-4.3 kHz, resonant high-pass 174 Hz, very fast decay, 3-band EQ
about.description: Layered with the snares on the backbeat from bar 29 to bar 77. Reverb (wet 0.31) widens it.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: two-octave-down wavetable, 2 unison layers, some drive, open ladder low-pass 14.8 kHz, short decay
about.description: A 16th-note arpeggio over G, B-flat, C and D in the low register, from bar 13 to the end (pattern A, then B from bar 33). Reverb and delay thicken the line.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: 10-layer unison table, ladder low-pass 3 kHz, sustaining envelope, slow 0.13 Hz LFO on the layer count, 3 voices
about.description: Quiet three-note chords that last a bar each, through the whole song (bars 1-84). They change pattern at bars 33 and 49, and a stereo delay adds movement.
